summary: Ligand Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K disclosing a fourth amendment to its credit agreement and a proposed private placement of $550 million aggregate principal amount of convertible senior notes due 2031, with an option for initial purchasers to buy up to an additional $82.5 million. The amendment adjusts minimum Consolidated EBITDA covenants to $100M for periods ending June 2026 through March 2027, then $150M thereafter. The offering is to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A. This is a capital markets financing event, not a merger, tender, or special situation. The registrant is the issuer. Watch for note pricing, conversion terms, and any impact on leverage or share count.
